We use character error rate (CER) as our evaluation metric ... The unsupervised neural model for Russian achieves 45.8 BLEU score ...

We use character error rate (CER) as our evaluation metric. We compute CER as the ratio of the character-level edit distance between the predicted original script sequence and the human annotation to the length of the annotation sequence in characters.
Each sentence in the validation and test sets is annotated by one of the two native speaker annotators, following guidelines similar to those designed for the Arabizi BOLT data.
